content:
Overview

Jeonju is a city in JNB with a population of 654,000. The culinary capital of Korea, famous for its Hanok Village, bibimbap, and rich cultural heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
